name: Homey Pro
short_desc: Run the Homey Self-Hosted smart-home hub
author: Athom
description: Homey Self-Hosted Server runs the Homey Pro smart-home platform as a container on your own hardware. It supports thousands of devices and brands over Wi-Fi and LAN, and is managed through the Homey mobile and web apps. Note: Zigbee, Z-Wave, Bluetooth and Infrared require Homey Pro hardware and are not available in the self-hosted server.
